race.description: Rq Supports Safety In Racing Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: ANOTHER CASHIE (12) caught plenty of eyes fresh when flashing home from a long way back to just miss. Is sure to have come on from that and is drawn much kinder this time. Gets the nod. STRADA VARENNA (3) has done little wrong this campaign, winning stylishly here two back before being run down late as favourite at the Gold Coast. At her top now and looms as the obvious danger. HE'S TRU BLUE (5) was good when last sighted back in May when just missing here in tough conditions. Has trialled well in readiness and reunites with Thompson from the inside pillar. Bit to like. DARK ARTS (4) went under as fav first-up but was strong late, then hit the line hard at the Goldy after being steadied near the 300m. Peaking now and with a clear passage home, he can play a major role.
